text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging @jordan (oncall) — spike observed on api-prod. p95 text-gen latency x3, streaming connections growing, worker queues backing up. Auto-alerts triggered.

jordan-oncall: Ack. Jumping in now. Routing to eng-runtime + SRE.

alex-sre: Looking at instance pool a2: long-lived streaming connections are tying up threads and KV cache. Non-streaming requests are fine. Suggest temporary disable of streaming across public endpoints to free capacity.

maria-runtime: I can flip the feature flag `enable_streaming` -> `false` per-region. That will drop new streaming sessions but preserve non-streaming API. Also recommend tightening connection rate limits while we stabilize.

sam-product: Want to know customer impact before we flip. Which customers use streaming heavily? We should update status page if this hits public customers.

leo-support: We have 3 enterprise customers on streaming dedicated flows; I'll notify their CSMs and open incident tickets. Also will coordinate any in-product messaging.

jordan-oncall: Plan: 1) Canary disable streaming in region A now 2) Apply per-key connection throttle (100 conn/min) 3) Observe 10m for p95/queue improvements 4) If good, roll global 5) Keep streaming disabled for up to 1h and re-enable progressively with windowing. Starting step 1.

maria-runtime: Commands I'll run for canary:

```bash
# disable streaming flag for api-service in prod region A (canary)
curl -X POST "https://config.prod.internal/flags/enable_streaming" -d '{"value":false,"env":"prod","scope":"region:A"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $CFG_TOKEN"

# fallback: restart api-service in prod-a to pick up flag quickly
kubectl -n redwood rollout restart deployment/api-service --context=prod-a
```

deploy-bot: Started flag change rollout (canary) — rollout id r-2026-03-15-005.

alex-sre: Applying temporary gateway throttle now so new streaming connections don't overwhelm remaining capacity.

```bash
# set per-key conn limit via gateway config service
curl -X POST https://gw.prod.internal/limits -d '{"limit":100,"scope":"per_key"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $GATEWAY_TOKEN"
```

maria-runtime: Observability update (canary):

```
before_canary: p95=1200ms queue_depth=1400 active_streams=860
after_canary (5m): p95=340ms queue_depth=120 active_streams=60
```

maria-runtime: Canary looks good — p95 and queues improving. Waiting another 5m to confirm stability before region B/C.

sam-product: Please post a short status update: "We are temporarily disabling streaming responses to stabilize latency. Non-streaming API remains available. We will provide updates in this incident thread."

leo-support: Notified affected CSMs and created tickets INC-12345, INC-12346, INC-12347. CSMs will reach out to customers in next 10m.

jordan-oncall: Proceed with global rollout after 10m if metrics hold. Handoff: I'll stay until roll completes and then pass to @alex for monitoring; @maria will take next shift for runtime follow-up.

alex-sre: Set alert thresholds for recovery/rollback: p95 > 800ms OR queue_depth > 500 triggers auto action. Documented rollback command.

```bash
# rollback (re-enable streaming)
curl -X POST "https://config.prod.internal/flags/enable_streaming" -d '{"value":true,"env":"prod"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $CFG_TOKEN"
# remove gateway throttle
curl -X DELETE https://gw.prod.internal/limits/conn_limit -H "Authorization: Bearer $GATEWAY_TOKEN"
```

deploy-bot: Global rollout complete — streaming disabled in prod regions A/B/C (rollout id r-2026-03-15-005).

maria-runtime: Post-rollout metrics: p95 dropped from ~1200ms -> 330ms, queue_depth down to ~90, active_streams collapsed. Continuing to monitor. We'll plan to keep streaming disabled for up to 1 hour and then re-enable with aggressive connection windowing (max 30s idle close) and progressive ramp.

sam-product: Thanks. I'll coordinate a small status page update + support blurb.

leo-support: Support tickets updated with mitigation steps and ETA. CSMs informed.

jordan-oncall: Passing monitoring to @alex. I'll remain reachable for the next 30m then hand off to @maria for post-incident cleanup and the postmortem. Please capture timeline + commands in the postmortem doc. :thumbsup:

alex-sre: Acknowledged. I've set Grafana alerts and pager thresholds. Will reopen thread if any regressions.

maria-runtime: After stabilization we'll plan a safe rollout path for streaming with backpressure (early-eject long sessions, streaming windowing, per-key limits) and an official KB for customers.

jordan-oncall: Good work team — keeping incident open for postmortem notes.

incident-bot: Incident updated: severity=SEV2, owners=[jordan-oncall, alex-sre, maria-runtime], linked_tickets=[INC-12345,INC-12346,INC-12347].
